summary: Frontend-only regression on Ledger tab Position hero after compact-card + chip-restructure fixes. Verified: compact hero card renders with POSITION label + 'Net Payable ₹79,100' headline, split bar height measured at exactly 7px with animated green (~80px) + red (~244px) segments, legend shows Receivable ₹38,900 · 3 and Payable ₹1,18,000 · 4, and both chips display FULL party names ('Mehta Enterprises', 'Indian Export House') with amounts stacked below (no truncation). Tapping Top Debtor navigated to /ledger/LED010 and Top Creditor to /ledger/LED001. Regressions clean: select mode (long-press) hides the hero (Position label not visible), search 'Mehta' filters to 1 row, Credit filter reduces list to 6 rows, sort chips render. No blocking issues found.

issues: chipAmt font is 10px which is on the small side — legible on 390x844 viewport but borderline for accessibility; consider bumping to TYPOGRAPHY.xs (11–12).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported' on RN web. This is an RN-web limitation (JS-based animation fallback works), no fix required. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/ledger.tsx:1287-1288

Deprecation warnings emitted on load ('shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'). Likely from third-party libs (Swipeable / Modal shadows). Not blocking but should be tracked.

critical_code_review_comments: ledger.tsx is 1327 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider extracting CreateLedgerModal, FilterModal, and PositionHero into separate files.

PositionBar animation useEffect only depends on [recvPct, payPct] which is fine, but Animated values r/p are not reset when values change — bar will still animate from previous value to new value which is desired behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 scenarios verified: compact hero, chip name visibility, chip navigation Debtor+Creditor, select-mode hides hero, search + credit filter regressions)
